decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (NG 1, NG 2, NG 6, NG 7, NG 8, NG 9, NG 10, NG 11, NG13, NG 14, NG 15 Received 28 June 2010; NG 3 (Rev B) Received 15/11/2010; NG 4 Rev B; NG 5 Rev B; NG12 Rev B; NG21 Rev B; NG22 Rev B; Received 28/11/2016; NGBT-revis B; Received 18/01/2017.) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces shall be those approved by planning permission 01254/73/P8(3) on 28 January 2015.

Condition : 3 - Before the development is commenced a scheme for protecting the proposed residential accommodation from excessive external noise shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and any works which form part of such a scheme shall be completed before any part of the development is first occupied or used.

Condition : 4 - The parking, loading and turning spaces shown on drawing No. NG 3 (Rev B) Received 15/11/2010 shall be constructed and available for use before first occupation of any part of the development and such spaces shall not be used for any other purposes.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The premises shall be used for A2 or B1 and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class       of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
Condition : 7 - The use hereby permitted shall not be carried on outside the following times 0900 to 1700 Monday to Fridays and 0900 to 1300 Saturdays and not at all on Sundays.

Condition : 8 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.
Condition : 9 - The hard and soft landscape works shall be carried out in accordance with the details approved by planning permission 01254/73/P8(10) on 21 January 2015.

Condition : 10 - The refuse storage area hereby approved shall be screened on all sides by a two-metre high close boarded fence, with self closing gates and shall be provided with recyclable materials storage as follows: a recycling estate frame (1 metre deep by 3.65 metres wide) comprising with five 240 litre bins for paper, glass and tins and cans or, alternatively, three free standing 240 litre bins for paper, tins and mixed glass (dimensions for each bin - 585mm wide and 740 mm deep), one 360 litre bin for plastic (Dimensions 600mm wide and 880mm deep) and one 1100 litre bin for cardboard (Dimensions 1.27 metre wide and 1metre deep), together with one 1100 litre 'euro bin' for general refuse material for the flats and a separate 1100 litre 'euro bin' for the office use.

Condition : 11 - Before the development hereby approved is first occupied, at either end of the vehicle access under the building, a speed bump shall be installed extending across the full width access (except for a 1 metre wide section in the centre to provide level access for wheelchairs), with a height of 75mm and a depth of between 400 and 500mm. Within the access, lighting shall be provided as approved under Condition 10, shall be permanently retained and shall be operational during the hours of darkness.
description: Variation of condition 2 (plans) to allow internal alterations to the layout of the flats of planning permission 01254/73/P8 approved 10/02/2010
